label: Inverted Pleated + Basic Flap
description: The inverted-pleat lower pocket with flap sits at the intersection of style and function: a central inverted pleat expands the patch as the pocket fills, providing significantly more carrying volume than a flat patch, while a flap closes over the top to keep contents secure and present a neat, traditional silhouette. It is a country-sporting detail associated with shooting jackets, stalking coats, and heavy-duty tweed commissions where the wearer genuinely needs to carry items in the pocket without distorting the jacket's hang.
